svg.text: FocusTimer3 Layered Architecture (after Phase 1 refactor)
Dependencies point downward only; the pure-logic layer is UI/device-free and unit-testable offline
1. Pages
Index (timer) · Notes · Statistics · Report
Only compose components, hold state and orchestrate lifecycle (Index: 782 -> 566 lines)
2. Components (10)
Shared BottomNavBar + 9 home widgets (timer ring, duration, subject, today stats...)
Props down, callbacks up -> one-way data flow; components never mutate state directly
3. Pure Logic / Domain (no UI, no device)
TimerEngine state machine · LearningAnalysisService rule engine (scoring & weekly report)
CardDataBuilder card formatting · FocusMode / Sedentary business rules
Deterministic output for given input -> verified offline in milliseconds; main target of unit tests
74 offline unit cases
4. Repository
FocusSessionStore: single entry point for reading/writing focus records (facade + delegation)
Pages ask for data, never knowing where it lives; storage can be swapped behind this layer
5. Platform / Storage
preferences KV store · relationalStore database · SensorServiceKit sensors
FormKit widget · distributedDataObject cross-device continuation
Quality gates: small Git commits -> cloud CI repo checks -> DevEco full local compile (type check) -> hypium unit tests -> emulator/device
Phase 2 adds an LLM implementation in layer 3: DeepSeek streaming online, automatic fallback to the rule engine offline, same interface
